newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Barrick said buying A$ for GCM bid.
newsitem.headline: Barrick said buying A$ for GCM bid.

text.p: Speculation that Canada's Barrick Gold Corp was readying a takeover bid for Australian gold miner Great Central Mines Ltd (GCM) was reinforced by developments in the foreign exchange market, dealers said on Wednesday.
Dealers said a large buy order for Australian dollars worth around A$450 million from a Canadian corporate saw the local currency surge around 1-1/2 Canadian cents offshore.
"The talk is it came from Barrick which needs the dollars to pay for Great Central," said one trader.
The local dollar was at C$1.0314/25 in early Australian trading, up from C$1.0179/90 here late on Tuesday.
The Australian newspaper reported on Wednesday that Barrick was expected to launch a A$3.40 per share cash takeover bid for Great Central Mines as early as today.
The bid would value the Australian miner at A$863 million.
Great Central shares closed up 12 cents at A$2.70 on Tuesday.
